title: resolve_secret_uri returns Result<_, String> not typed error
description: crates/core/src/secret.rs: resolve_secret_uri returns Result<Option<String>, String>. String errors in library APIs lose type information, cannot be matched by callers, and violate the project convention of typed error enums. Fix: define a SecretError enum (or add a SecretResolution variant to ProtocolError/StorageError) and return Result<Option<String>, SecretError>.
